name: The Master
source:
A mysterious and charismatic man, capable of anything and even the worst to achieve his goal.

Brief information:
Symbol: Mask
Best quality: Sharp Mind
Worst quality: Callousness
Main fear: Loneliness
The most important thing in life: Achieve his goal
Flower: White Lily
Musical instrument: Organ

"Free will and reason are able to direct the potential to either side. You just need to choose this side".

[From in-game character profile]
